problems.note: The narration says Zoe adds 3 more dots, but the picture shows only the full ten-frame (10 dots). The 3 added dots are never shown, and a single ten-frame can't hold 13. A child who listens by ear hears the addition, but the picture doesn't show it. Consider showing the 3 extra dots in a second frame, or rewording to 'Zoe has 10 dots. She adds 3 more.' The item also tests mental addition within 20, which may be a bit beyond the estimate-and-count focus of this skill.

Card 6 ('Now it is your turn. Guess first. Then count to check!') shows only a frog emoji. A child has nothing to estimate or count there, and no practice item follows that uses the frog as the object to count. Consider a countable picture (for example a row of 6 or 7 emoji) so the closing card matches the instruction.
